hypotheses.title: Improving Heart Disease Prediction
hypotheses.statement: Using feature selection techniques may improve heart disease prediction accuracy.
hypotheses.research_question: Does feature selection improve prediction accuracy?
hypotheses.method: Compare machine learning models with and without feature selection.
hypotheses.expected_outcome: Improved prediction accuracy with relevant features.

hypotheses.title: Comparing Machine Learning Models
hypotheses.statement: Random Forest may perform better than Logistic Regression for heart disease prediction.
hypotheses.research_question: Which model provides better prediction performance?
hypotheses.method: Compare Random Forest and Logistic Regression using the same dataset.
hypotheses.expected_outcome: One model may achieve better accuracy and F1-score.

hypotheses.title: Effect of Data Balancing
hypotheses.statement: Balancing an imbalanced dataset may improve the recall of heart disease prediction.
hypotheses.method: Compare model performance before and after applying a data-balancing technique.
hypotheses.expected_outcome: The balanced dataset may improve recall for the minority class.
